import json,collections
items=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
for i in [4,18]:
 a[i]['answer']=next(k for k,v in items[i]['options'].items() if v=='baseline dot')
open('answers.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in a))
answers=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(items)==len(answers)==86
for r,a in zip(items,answers):
 assert r['item_id']==a['item_id']
 assert a['answer'] in r['options']
 assert a['confidence'] in ['high','low']
assert len(set(a['item_id'] for a in answers))==86
counts=collections.Counter(r['options'][a['answer']] for r,a in zip(items,answers))
print('Validated count, order, unique IDs, and option letters:',len(answers))
print('Counts:',dict(counts))
print('Low confidence:',sum(a['confidence']=='low' for a in answers))
